scope: Authored locomotion only. Eight camera-relative facing views, eight successive walk drawings per view. No mirrored directions or interpolated angle frames.

shane-base.brief: Preserve Shane's approved adult likeness, black beanie, hoodie, denim jacket, cargo trousers and black/white trainers. Empty-handed eight-phase walk in eight full-body directions. Left heel contact/down/opposite passing/up, then opposite contact/down/passing/up. Same camera, body scale and lighting; transparent 8 by 8 grid. Right-facing rows point to the image's right edge and left-facing rows to its left edge; rear row shows no face.

natalie-base.brief: Preserve Natalie's approved adult likeness and build, black hair and short fringe, glasses, piercings, tattoos, olive jumper, belted black jeans and boots. Empty-handed eight-phase walk in eight full-body directions, regular transparent 8 by 8 grid. Clear left/right foot alternation and opposing arm swing; front, right diagonals/profile, back, left diagonals/profile.

elowen.brief: Preserve the moth witch's face, braid, burgundy hat and dress, cream moth cape, lantern and book. Eight full-body directions with eight alternating-foot walk drawings each, transparent regular grid. Explicit image-right profiles in rows 2–4 and image-left profiles in rows 6–8; rear view shows the back of the cape.
elowen.sourceConstruction: Original seven side/rear/diagonal rows plus accepted generated front footfall strip, assembled with measured uniform scaling and fixed body root.

review: Viewed full source sheets before packing. Both side profiles, front, rear and diagonal views are distinct. Direction slots are intended 45-degree sectors; hand-painted views are not calibrated 3D renders. Step labels describe the intended gait order, not motion-capture measurements.

rejected.reason: Elowen's initial draft duplicated left-facing profiles where right-facing views were required. Not included in the runtime or contractor art package.
